GPU Performance Engineer

Work on our high-performance compute stack. You'll profile CUDA kernels
with Nsight Compute, optimize memory access patterns, and collaborate
with compiler teams on PTX code generation.

What you'll do:
- Profile and optimize CUDA kernels for H100 and B200
- Design parallel algorithms for sparse linear algebra
- Write performance-critical code that must meet strict latency SLAs

Requirements: 3+ years CUDA, strong C++, experience with HPC workloads.
